chesttracker.config.gui.useCustomNamesIn: Whether to replace title text in GUIs with custom names, if one is present. Note that this may cause compatibility issues with servers that use fonts for GUI textures, such as Origin Realms.

chesttracker.config.storage.storageBacke: Defines the format that Memory Banks are stored between worlds/sessions.
Stores all Memory Banks as JSON files in your game's 'chesttracker' directory. Readable, but takes up more disk space.
Stores all Memory Banks as NBT files in your game's 'chesttracker' directory. More compact, but not readable without an external viewer. Recommended option.
Stores Memory Banks in game memory.
Warning: all Memory Banks stored this way are lost when the game closes.
chesttracker.config.storage.json.readabl: Whether the JSON files in the memory directory should be readable, or compacted.
chesttracker.config.compatibility.shulke: Chest Tracker overwrites Shulker Box Tooltip's server-side preview for ender chests with it's own client-side one, reading from the current Memory Bank. This functions on Realms and servers without Shulker Box Tooltip installed.
現在のメモリバンクを使用してWTHITのハイライトを表示することができます。WTHITのプラグインマネージャの下に追加の設定があります。
